branded.why: A well-sold brand, but one supermarket brand among many, no part of a food culture of its own.

about.text: A trademarked, long-aged hard Gouda-style cheese, aged 36, 55 or 100 weeks, sold under the trader Velder's brand. It is said to come from Bodegraven in South Holland, though the brand may not be made there.

sources.text: The brand, the ageing and the origin, from these.
